### [New SaaS Offering] Android Dev Environment Setup on Fiverr

**Tagline:** Turn your Android phone into a real development machine. No root required.

**Description:** I'll configure a full Linux development environment on your Android device using Termux — Python, Node, Git, SSH, local AI inference, the works. Built for developers who need a portable setup that actually works, not a toy terminal.

**Key Features:**
- Termux full environment setup and hardening
- Python, Node, Rust toolchain installation
- Ollama local AI inference configured
- SSH keys, Git config, dotfiles
- SD card storage routing for large projects
- Custom .bashrc with productivity aliases

**Pricing:** Flat fee $99 / $49 add-on for custom tooling
**Estimated ROI:** Replaces need for $500+ laptop for remote dev work

**Payment Method:** Lightning Network (BTC)
**Lightning Address:** bleaknarratives@speed.app

### [New SaaS Offering] Local AI Chatbot Setup on Fiverr

**Tagline:** Your own private AI assistant. No subscriptions. No data leaving your machine.

**Description:** I'll set up a fully local, private AI chatbot on your hardware using Ollama and open-source models. No cloud dependency, no monthly fees after setup, no data harvesting. Runs on modest hardware. You own it completely.

**Key Features:**
- Ollama installation and model configuration
- Model selection matched to your hardware specs
- Simple web UI for non-technical users
- Basic system prompt tuning for your use case
- Documentation so you can maintain it yourself

**Pricing:** Flat fee $149 setup / $49 for additional model configs
**Estimated ROI:** Replaces $20-100/month ChatGPT or Copilot subscription within 2 months

**Payment Method:** Lightning Network (BTC)
**Lightning Address:** bleaknarratives@speed.app
